answer: Concretely, the economy can lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. An identity earns only when its raven recurs, its vine survives audit, and a pearl from an unlinked peer confirms it.
